title: Headless App Engine Binary Command Protocol Foundations
description:
Wave 0 of the approved plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/every-single-app-must-joyful-pudding.md: every app must have a headless engine driven by bidirectional streaming of typed binary commands over one protocol; every UI interaction is just a forwarded command; every app declares typed configuration + input/output ports; a workflow is wired apps + configuration, executable fully headless with zero UI-mock API.

This ticket covers Wave 0 — the file-disjoint foundational work packages that precede the WIT/ABI flip:
- WP-0A: new protocol_channel crate (AppCommand/AppFrame frame taxonomy, codec, hex fixture corpus) at 🧰️framework/🛍️product/💻️os/🔨️module/📡️protocol/🧵️channel/⚡️implementation/🦀️rust/, re-exported through the protocol facade.
- WP-0B: JS-callable codecs — PackValueCodec (byte-exact twin of store::pack_rt::encode_json_value/decode_json_value) and AppChannelCodec (frame codec twin) as new regions in 🧰️framework/🛍️product/💻️os/⚡️implementation/🟦️typescript/📦️index.ts, plus matching Rust-side pack-Value fixture tests in the store crate, with hex corpora duplicated verbatim on both sides as the drift alarm.
- WP-0C: framework core additions (AppIo, ConfigRecord, ConfigSpec, CommandGrammar regions + AppDefinition.config/command_grammar/io) in 🧰️framework/⚡️implementation/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs, plus registry generator emitRustArtifacts → 🤖️generated/🦀️artifacts.rs in 🔌️plugin/⚡️implementation/🟦️typescript/📇️registry/📜️script.ts.

Full architecture, later waves (ABI flip, runner reshape, per-app fan-out, outliers) and verification plan are in the plan file. This ticket's scope is Wave 0 only; later waves get their own tickets/reopens.
summary:
Waves 0-1 of the headless-engine/binary-command-channel program (plan: /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/every-single-app-must-joyful-pudding.md).

Wave 0: new protocol_channel crate (AppCommand/AppFrame frame taxonomy, 40 tests, golden hex fixture corpus); framework-core AppIo/ConfigSpec/CommandGrammar/AppDefinition fields; registry emitRustArtifacts generator. Caught and fixed a real design bug along the way: store::pack_rt::encode_json_value wraps a full compressed .spk container (200+ byte floor, non-deterministic DEFLATE) and is wrong for a per-frame wire protocol — added lightweight store::pack_rt::encode_wire_value/decode_wire_value on pack::encode_record_body/decode_record_body instead, and rebuilt the TS PackValueCodec mirror on that (now byte-exact both directions, deleted the CRC32C/BLAKE3/deflate code that was only needed for the wrong primitive).

Wave 1 (ABI flip): world.wit collapsed from ~18 per-verb JSON-string functions to 5 (manifest/instantiate-app/exchange/migrate-document/clear-instance-guard). Plugin SDK: three new additive DocumentApp default methods (handle_typed_command/config_spec/apply_config_bytes, all defaulting to no-op/None) plus matching PluginApp methods implemented on the existing VcsDocumentApp<A> impl with a legacy wire-value-envelope fallback — deliberately NOT a breaking trait change, so the other 51 apps keep compiling AND keep working at runtime throughout the staged rollout (avoided a wrapper-type/trait-coherence dead end here, documented in the plan file). plugin_exchange added to plugin_runtime, reusing existing dispatch/commit/refresh-hash internals rather than reimplementing them. Shooting app converted as the pilot (ShootingConfig, ShootingCommand DslOps enum, typed dispatch for 17 of ~40 actions, rest via legacy fallback) — builds as a real wasm32-wasip2 component, 28 passing tests. Wasmtime host rewritten to the same 5-function surface (deleted per-verb methods entirely since no caller outside this crate used them independently of the WIT surface). Dev-shell JS glue, framework-core PluginWorkerClient/PluginWasmHandle, and a new AppChannelClient (in the os-product TS file, not framework-core, to avoid a dependency cycle) rewritten to the 4-method channel API. React renderer's adaptPluginHandle rewritten as a compatibility adapter over AppChannelClient so the ~24k-line renderer's dispatch/refresh business logic didn't need a rewrite; SectionProbe kind numbering mirrored verbatim from the Rust side. wgpu renderer boot layer explicitly left unfixed (already on an older, separate ABI pre-dating this change; not the default renderer; flagged as follow-up).

Known gaps for follow-up work packages: CommandText frames stubbed (Error/unsupported); DocumentCommand frame only maps the 6 magic history-action strings, not a real store::DocumentCommand wire codec; no persistent per-instance outbox/DocumentChanged unsolicited frames yet (pending_effects only, drained once per batch); applyOperations/readAppDocument/loadAppDocument have no TS-side pack-container encoder yet so those adapter methods are undefined; wgpu boot.ts untouched. Live dev-shell browser smoke test could not be completed — the cold multi-plugin wasm build was killed by the sandbox before finishing on 7 independent attempts (6 by a subagent, 1 by me); this is a sandbox/environment constraint, not a code defect (every attempt compiled further with zero errors before being killed), but it means Wave 1 is verified at the compile/unit-test level only, not with a live runtime confirmation. Downstream breakage in the headless run crate (🏃️run) and the wgpu renderer crate is expected and is Wave 2/3 scope, not fixed here.

All touched files listed below. Next: Wave 2 (runner + os workflow model) gets its own ticket.
